sourceText:
Creamed Venison
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 9:54pm

Ingredients




1 pound Cubed Elk/Deer round steak
3 tablespoons Margarine or butter
2 cups Medium white sauce
1 teaspoon Celery salt
teaspoon Pepper
3 tablespoons Chopped parsley
2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce
cup Pickle relish
cup Dry bread crumbs
2 tablespoons Margarine or butter

Preparation

1 Brown steak in 3 tablespoons margarine or butter. Add a small amount of water and cook in a covered skillet until tender, adding a little water from time to time as needed. When done add white sauce, seasonings, parsley and pickle relish. Put mixture in a greased casserole. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs and dot with margarine or butter. Bake in a moderate oven (350 degrees F.) until crumbs are browned.
